item.description: The El Niño that is making waves across the world brings with it a shuddering threat of food insecurity to Sri Lanka. Experts warn that, in the worst-case scenario, it could reduce Sri Lanka’s paddy harvest in the Maha 2026/27 by upwards of 30 percent. If so, Sri Lanka could begin to experience rice shortages, resulting in high consumer prices, beginning June 2027, once the existing rice stocks and the harvest from the Maha season are exhausted.
